_comment: Phase MC — the words a mail verb says when it CANNOT do what it was asked. Read by MailSetupLadder (mChatAI+ Swift), which carries an identical _fallback_only copy for offline first launch. The BUG this exists to kill: mail.search with zero authorized accounts used to answer `ok, 0 message(s) match`, so an assistant told the user it had searched and found nothing. Not-configured must never read as not-found. The rung NAMES and the probe ORDER are behaviour and live in Swift; only the copy, the one-click flags and the deep links live here, so the wording can improve with a git push and no rebuild. Swift clamps everything it reads: text is trimmed and capped, `open` is dropped unless its scheme is com.sevenhillsstudio.mchatai or https, and `one_click` is ANDed with the rungs that actually have an automatable action — so a bad edit here can make the copy worse but can never make a verb claim it did something it did not.

shellDown.blocker: mChatAIShell isn't connected, so nothing here can reach your mail.
shellDown.unlocks: The Shell is what talks to Google — reconnecting it restores reading, searching and drafting in one step.
shellDown.remedy: Open mChatAIShell from the menu bar and let it pair with mChatAI+, then ask again. Nobody can do this part for you — the two apps have to be paired on this Mac.

gwsMissing.blocker: The Google Workspace tools mChatAI+ signs in with aren't installed on this Mac yet.
gwsMissing.unlocks: Installing them is what lets you connect a Google account at all; it is the step before sign-in, not sign-in itself.
gwsMissing.remedy: Click Install Google Workspace Tools in AI Inbox, or let me run it for you — it takes about 30–60 seconds and needs nothing from you while it runs.

clientSecretMissing.blocker: There's no Google sign-in key on this Mac, so no account can be authorized yet.
clientSecretMissing.unlocks: Once the key is in place you can sign in as many Google accounts as you like, and mail can read every one of them.
clientSecretMissing.remedy: Open AI Inbox and follow “Connect AI Inbox to your Google account” — a one-time setup of about 90 seconds that ends with a client_secret.json file in ~/.config/gws/. I can't do this one for you: Google only issues that key through its own console, to you.

noAccounts.blocker: No Google account is connected yet, so there is no mailbox to read.
noAccounts.unlocks: Connect one and unread mail, search and message details all start working for that account — read-only, no permission to send.
noAccounts.remedy: Click Add a Google Account in AI Inbox, or say the word and I'll open Google's consent page in your browser. You have to finish the consent yourself; I can open it, I can't agree to it.

ready.blocker: Nothing is missing — mail is connected.
ready.unlocks: Reading, searching and drafting all work. Sending is the exception: every message still waits for you to approve it.

probe_failed_suffix: That check didn't complete ({error}), so treat this as unknown rather than as an empty inbox.
